name: What specific challenges affect countertop replacement in older Denver metro homes?

mainEntity.name: What specific challenges affect countertop replacement in older Denver metro homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver area and surrounding communities like Aurora and Centennial, older homes often present shifted foundations or settling that leave existing cabinets unlevel. Installing rigid stone slabs across uneven framing creates stress points that risk cracking. During renovations across the metro area, contractors inspect and shim base cabinets, ensuring a dead-level plane before slabs are laid down. Cold winter weather also requires letting natural stone acclimate to indoor household temperatures before applying adhesives or silicone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Settling foundations often leave cabinet runs uneven, requiring careful shimming so rigid stone avoids cracking, along with temperature acclimation during cold months.
